yt_description:
Ever wondered how computers sort lists? 🤔 Dive into the mesmerizing world of Bubble Sort! We'll break down this fundamental algorithm step-by-step with a super satisfying visual. Watch as elements 'bubble up' to their correct positions! Perfect for beginners and a fun refresher for seasoned devs. ✨

In this video:
✅ What is Bubble Sort?
✅ How does it work (visually)?
✅ Time Complexity explained (O(n²))
✅ When NOT to use Bubble Sort (and what to use instead!)
